title: ZKward
tagline: AI-managed USDC vault: 7 agents hedge privately with post-quantum ZK and fund their own inference
description: A vault that thinks for itself. Seven AI agents read prediction markets, hedge on perps, and pay their own inference bills via x402 on Hedera. Live on Sui mainnet with real money since June. Every hedge is sealed in post-quantum ZK, so nobody sees your position. No trusted setup.
how_its_made: Next.js/Vercel, Solidity on Hedera, Python STARK prover, HCS as a free audit log. Mirror Node replaced rate-limited Hashio RPC with pre-indexed reads. Hackiest bit: our perp venue returns a valid orderHash for orders it silently drops, so we verify fills by delta. We are getting crowdsourced data for trading from prediction markets.
auto_summary: A multi-chain vault platform uses AI agents to manage deposits, hedging, payments, and on-chain auditability across Sui, Hedera, and EVM systems.
